fx.direction: 1 source_currency = rate target_currency; target is always the base currency
fx.partial_payments: each payment settles at its own date's rate; differences go to account 7810
fx.rate_date: the policy date of the record, in the company time zone (spot rate of that day)
fx.rounding: half_even, once, when converting to base minor units

legitimate_patterns: split payments and lump-sum payments covering several invoices
short payment with a documented deduction and a credit note (accounts 4100/1200)
advance payments with no invoice reference held in 2350 Unapplied cash
recurring invoices with the same lines and amount but a different service period
timestamps written with other UTC offsets; always convert to the company time zone

period.rule: A record belongs to the period of its policy date, taken in the company time zone.

policy_date.note: If a ledger posting and the document disagree on a date, the document date wins.

conversions.payment_allocation: 1 if the payment is foreign else 0
conversions.period_classification: 1 if the invoice is foreign else 0

tolerance.rule: |claimed - expected| <= 1 + conversions (minor units of the claimed currency)
